behavior: Owned Black jump/heavy-zip approach while holding toward latches the near shoulder; the side stays fixed when the boss turns.
Y selects one authored rake for one HP; A selects a two-HP tear and immediate native kick-off on acceptance. Attack strength remains separate from the fifth HP argument.
Native boss attacks/committed escapes, R, hurt, death, form/room changes and target loss release; known native damage/get-up reactions are not attacks.
Hold has no ride timer. Only player velocity is written; native collision/gravity remain. Close movement/strike range gates prevent remote hits.
A lethal accepted tear can kick the still-owned rider after the victim is destroyed; a changed room/owner cancels it safely.
limits: Initial arena arrival is a compiled four-word entry fixture; original native boss encounter events and retry flags are used. Door/campaign entrance is not qualified.

Ownership, initial layouts, player healing, explicitly named interruptions and lethal one-HP setup are disposable fixtures on a copied latest battery. Normal boss moves have no NPC position/state/velocity/HP writes.
The wall target alone is parked. Its fresh hold input ends through separation before strike acceptance; no remote damage is observed.

Native collision can limit kick travel. Native mini-bosses 29/2A/2C/2D and the Conductor are qualified; Mega Venom has no new adapter. Later Talon Pounce/Freefall/Relentless changes are not implemented.
Hardware pacing, full-route balance and player acceptance remain unconfirmed. Perceptual audio review depends on reviewer capability; mixed native PCM is retained.

qualification.native_control_initial_attempts: Unisolated comparisons saw unrelated NPC contact/initial displacement. Final controls use initial separation and parked standing AI; native reactions and player physics are unchanged. These are input-route controls, not battle balance.

native_control_pairs.rule: Owned Boarding bit88 set in both ROMs. Initial enemies placed away from the player before inputs, standing AI parked; native reactions/hits remain. Compare controlled movement from frame30, normalize native idle99/100, retain state/action events for >=2 frames. X exact; transition jitter <=2 video frames.

qualification.superseded_wall: The first final wall trial was interrupted by an old NPC attack. The isolated control parks idle target from the entry prefix with native idle reentry, produces a fresh Y edge in hold, then releases before attack acceptance. It does not claim an accepted blocked strike.
qualification.native_control_inheritance: The full ARM9 code/state and every GMB/GAB/native resource are byte-identical to the d900 candidate used for the six exact native input comparisons; only ten private near-camera SCA offsets changed.

presentation.basis: Visual-only review of exact native-size every-frame sequences; near-side silhouette and distinct kick. Playback/audio not perceived.

feel.basis: Timing/motion evidence only: two-video-frame action entry, continuous sampled paths and stable shoulder; not a human fun verdict.

gameplay_correctness.basis: Implemented jump/heavy-zip paths, real HP, native shake-off and honest supported-target coverage.

safety.basis: Ownership/weak references, interrupts, stale-result and lethal/room-change ARM regressions plus live lethal control.

regression_save.basis: Independent focused/doc tests, native pairs and copied latest-battery purchase/refund/repurchase/save/Continue.

evidence_scope.basis: Exact hashes, clean composition, disclosed fixtures and replayable controls.

review.latest_qualitative_feedback: Both-facing and small-rig sequences are readable, track the sampled shoulder, and separate clearly; no obvious large discontinuity beyond the intended kick. Audio/player/hardware verdict remains open.
review.unresolved: Terra cannot watch normal-speed playback or hear audio through its interface; root audio tool also explicitly rejects audio input. Actual playback observation is requested from the player before asking Terra to close its gate.
